title: TCD-025 Macropore Main-Ledger Admission Readiness and Risk Reclassification

prior_blockers: active macropore persistent solute state incomplete under TCD-031
queue_context.remaining_question: whether the public/main balance observer can be corrected without changing state/control-volume semantics

public_balance_profile_contract.finding: each public balance may cover a selected layer interval Balnmi(Ly)..Balnma(Ly), not only the whole profile

macropore_water_state.finding: macropore water has domain-total accepted/result storage and layer-resolved current storage; accepted layer-resolved SrWaMpCpOld is combined across the two domains

macropore_transport_topology.finding: the unsaturated macropore route has explicit vertical transfer by layer, while the saturated part is solved as a domain-level concentration/storage reservoir spanning its active layer range

whole_profile_identity.finding: whole-profile macropore water and species mass identities are source-defined from external/internal transfers and domain-total beginning/end storage

direct_drain_partition.finding: FlMpOuDrMp is direct external Main-Bypass drainage; FlMpOuDrSo is routed through soil and must not be counted again as an external macropore output

reason: public balances can cut an arbitrary layer interval
saturated macropore transport is represented as a domain-level mixed reservoir rather than independent layer solute control volumes
no source-owned saturated-domain vertical solute boundary transfer exists for every possible interior public balance boundary
inventing such an interior boundary transfer from the residual would make the observer self-closing and would mask rather than test conservation
new_readiness_finding.consequence: a general TCD-025 correction cannot currently be certified as accounting-only observer plumbing for every supported public balance profile

risk_assessment.strictest_trigger: unresolved state/control-volume ownership with scientific consequences

admission_readiness.required_next_work: dedicated TCD-025 selected-profile state/control-volume qualification before any B3 admission
